name: VLA Energy Green Data Center - Arad
notes: Developer page lists a Green Data Center - Arad with high-capacity 110 kV / 400 kV grid access, integrated BESS, renewable energy and a scalable phased campus design; no MW figure or construction permit found.

name: NXDATA-3 Bucharest (NX-3/BUH3)
notes: Official NXDATA-3 page states 5 MW installed power and 3 MW IT power; Baxtel lists NXDATA-3 as a Bucharest site under construction with estimated Q4 2026 launch.

name: Portland Trust Bucharest DC1
notes: Baxtel lists Portland Trust Bucharest as under construction at 20 MW with estimated Q2 2026 launch; DataCenterMap describes a new 8,800+ sqm Bucharest facility on a 27,734 sqm plot with a 110/20 kV transformer station.

name: Portland Trust Bucharest DC2
notes: Baxtel lists Portland Trust Bucharest 2 as under construction/planned pipeline at 30 MW with estimated Q1 2027 launch; DataCenterMap describes it as a planned 20,000 sqm data center on Bd. Timisoara.

name: Voxility IR2 Bucharest
notes: Voxility page describes its new IR2 datacenter on Dimitrie Pompeiu Blvd. with 1 MW available at launch and support for high-density AI workloads.

name: Orange Romania - Bucharest 2
notes: DataCenter Forum reports Orange operates and owns commercial data centers in Bucharest, Brasov, Cluj-Napoca and Timisoara; DataCenterMap lists Orange Romania - Bucharest 2 at Drumul Taberei nr. 41.

name: GTS Telecom Bucharest Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists GTS Telecom: Bucharest as an operational carrier-neutral facility and shows GTS Telecom with 1 operational Bucharest site and 2.0 MW.

name: Solidus Ai Tech Bucharest Carrier-Neutral Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists a Solidus Ai Tech carrier-neutral Bucharest facility as construction/operational/planned and shows a site under construction at 8 MW with estimated Q4 2026 launch.

name: Kyndryl Romania Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com listing places Kyndryl Romania Data Center at Soseaua Orhideelor, 060071 Bucuresti; no public power capacity found.

name: Romania/Bucharest unnamed 40-45 MW data center projects
notes: Knight Frank/Ziarul Financiar reporting cited by Baxtel says two Romanian projects totaling 40-45 MW were awaiting local PUZ planning; Business Forum separately says several recent projects in and around Bucharest total over 100 MW. Locations/developers were not disclosed, so assigned to Bucuresti because corroborating market commentary identifies the capital as the near-term project focus.

name: WhiteHat Rotunda Data Center
notes: Public listings identify WhiteHat as a colocation/interconnection facility in Rotunda, Bacau County, with regional fiber/IX connectivity; public power data is inconsistent or not directly verified, so capacity is null.

name: HZone Oradea Data Center
notes: HZone official page states it operates its own data center in Oradea, Bihor County, in the Calea Borsului - Industrial Park 1 area, offering VPS, dedicated servers and colocation; capacity not published.

name: WhiteHat DC2 Braila
notes: Inflect lists WhiteHat DC2 as an operating colocation facility at 14 Strada Mare, Braila, with RO-CIX access; DataCenterPlatform corroborates WhiteHat Braila at Strada Mare 14. Inflect snippet reports 250 kVA but page details are limited, so capacity is null.

name: Orange Business Services Brasov 1
notes: Inflect lists Orange Business Services Brasov at 9 Strada Mihail Sadoveanu with 1,200 kW total power and 72,000 sq ft; DataCenter Forum says Orange owns commercial data centers in Brasov and is the only provider with two data centers in multiple Romanian cities including Brasov.

name: Orange Business Brasov 2 Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists Orange Business Brasov 2 at Calea Bucuresti 36; DataCenter Forum corroborates Orange owns two commercial data centers in Brasov. Capacity not found.

name: DEER modular data center - Brasov
notes: Balkan Green Energy News reports DEER is considering three modular/interoperable data centers in Cluj-Napoca, Brasov and Ploiesti, possibly using underground sites such as salt mines or bomb shelters; no capacity or permit data found.
